newsitem.title: USA: Service Corp Q1 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: Service Corp Q1 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full company name is Service Corp International .

1997 Q1 results include a $68.1 million gain ($43.4 million after tax) on sale of the company's remaining investment in Equity Corporation International, which resulted in an after-tax gain of $0.17 fully diluted earnings per share ($0.18 primary).

The company also recorded a $40.8 million after tax extraordinary loss related to the early retirement of certain outstanding debt which resulted in a fully diluted loss per share of $0.16 (primary loss of $0.17).
First Call 1997 Q1 estimate was $0.34 a share.
